title: Ardhanarishvara: Aadha Shiv Aadhi Parvati! ☯️
tagline: Ardhanarishvara half Shiva half Parvati unity duality
verified_fact: Ardhanarishvara is a composite form of Shiva and Parvati — right half is Shiva, left half is Parvati. It represents the inseparability of Purusha and Prakriti (male and female cosmic principles). Brahma requested this form to understand creation.
voiceover_script: Aadha Shiv, aadhi Parvati — ye hai Ardhanarishvara! Dakshina bhag hai Shiva — Purusha, chetan, nirgun. Vama bhag hai Parvati — Prakriti, shakti, saguN. Brahma srishti karna chahte the par samajh nahi aaya kaise. Tab Shiv aur Parvati ne ek ho ke dikhaya — Purusha aur Prakriti ek dusre ke bina adhure hain. Creation ke liye dono ki zaroorat hai!
debate_question: Ardhanarishvara aaj ke gender equality concept se kaise juda hai?
pinned_comment: ☯️ Aadha Shiv aadhi Parvati — unity of opposites! Om Namah Shivaya!

Ardhanarishvara is a composite form of Shiva and Parvati — right half is Shiva, left half is Parvati. It represents the inseparability of Purusha and Prakriti (male and female cosmic principles). Brahma requested this form to understand creation.
